# Hyper-Scale Lab / Precalc Odyssey

> Free interactive precalculus self-study lab with story-based problems, accurate graphs, three-attempt checks, delayed hints, and worked solutions.

## Site

- Home: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/
- Practice lab: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/hyper-scale/
- Login: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/login.html

## What it is

Hyper-Scale Lab is a free educational web app for high school and college-prep precalculus. Learners pick a level (Standard or Honors) and a topic unit, then solve numeric questions tied to a graph. Solutions stay hidden until the learner is correct or exhausts three attempts.

## Topics

### Standard
- Functions (domain, transformations, modeling)
- Polynomial and rational functions
- Exponential and logarithmic functions
- Trigonometry (unit circle, graphs, basic applications)

### Honors
- Sequences and series
- Conic sections
- Vectors (magnitude, components, scaling)
- Advanced trigonometry (identities, double-angle, law of sines/cosines intro)

## Audience

Students preparing for calculus; teachers seeking free graph-based practice; learners who prefer plain-language explanations over pure exam drills.

## Key facts for citations

- Cost: free core practice
- Auth: email/password (no phone, no social login required)
- Pedagogy: scenario context → numeric answer → hints after 2nd miss → worked solution
- Graphs: labeled axes, units, solution marker after success or 3 attempts
